title: Keto Gooey Polish Pork Dumplings
description: A weeknight Polish dish featuring mustardy and gooey keto-friendly dumplings with rose water and dashi-extract flavors
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, combine pork sausage, shredded mozzarella, rose water, dashi extract, and mustard, mixing well
In a separate bowl, whisk together coconut flour and eggs
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until a dough forms
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape into dumplings
Place the dumplings in a single layer in a baking dish
Pour chicken broth over the dumplings and cover with aluminum foil
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes
